orderHow.q: How do I buy a part?
orderHow.a: Pick a part in the shop, add it to the cart and place the order with your name and phone number.
steps: Open the part in the shop and tap “Add to cart”
In the cart tap “Checkout” and enter your name and phone
Transfer the amount to the card shown and upload the receipt

pickup.q: When do I see the pickup address?
pickup.a: Once your receipt is approved, the order page shows the workshop address, map, phone and pickup code.
steps: Open the order under Profile → My orders
When the status is “Purchased” you'll see the address and pickup code
Show the code at the workshop and collect the part

cancel.q: How do I cancel an order?
cancel.a: The order page has a “Cancel order” button. The refund amount is shown in the confirmation dialog.
steps: Open the order and tap “Cancel order”
Check the amount in the dialog and confirm
If the button is gone, the cancellation window has passed — write to us

receiptPending.q: My receipt has been under review for a long time
receiptPending.a: Our team checks every receipt by hand. This usually takes a few hours.
steps: Make sure the receipt is sharp and fully visible
Check that the order number is in the transfer comment
If it's been a long time, select the order and write to us

receiptRejected.q: My receipt was rejected — what now?
receiptRejected.a: The reason is shown on the order page: blurry receipt, wrong amount or a duplicate.
steps: Read the reason on the order page
Upload the correct, clear receipt again
If you paid but the receipt isn't accepted, write to us

wrongAmount.q: I sent the wrong amount or to the wrong card
wrongAmount.a: Don't worry — every payment is checked by hand and our team will sort it out.
steps: Save the receipt from your banking app
In the form below, pick the order and attach the receipt as a photo
Tell us how much you sent and to which card

renderFailed.q: The visualisation failed or showed an error
renderFailed.a: If a render ends with an error, the credit is refunded automatically.
steps: Check your connection and try again
Look for a “Refunded” entry in Settings → Credit history
If it keeps happening, write to us with a screenshot

renderQuality.q: The result doesn't look like my car
renderQuality.a: Quality depends a lot on the photo. A sharp, well-lit photo gives the best result.
steps: Shoot the car in daylight without harsh shadows
Keep the whole car in frame and follow the camera's angle guide
Check that the right car model is selected

credits.a: Each render uses a credit. Free credits renew every month; upgrade your plan for more.
steps: Check your remaining credits on the profile
Wait for the new month or upgrade your plan
If a credit was taken by mistake, write to us

login.q: How do I change my password?
login.a: You can change it from your profile. You'll need your current password.
steps: Open Profile → Edit profile
In “Password”, enter your current and new password
Use at least 8 characters with letters and numbers

contacts.q: I want to change my phone or email
contacts.a: Name, phone and email are changed on the edit profile page.
steps: Open Profile → Edit profile
Enter the new details and save
If you see an error, send us its text

language.q: How do I change language or currency?
language.a: Pick language and currency in Settings; your choice is kept for next time.
steps: Open Profile → Settings
Choose the language and currency you want

sellerPayout.q: When do I get paid for a sold part?
sellerPayout.a: After the customer collects the part, the payout is sent to your workshop's card by hand. You'll see its status on the order in the Dashboard.
steps: Check the payout status under Dashboard → Orders
Confirm the pickup code when the customer collects the part
If the payout is late, pick the order and write to us

sellerAddPart.a: New parts are added on the “New part” page in the Dashboard. Check the photo and the required fields.
steps: Make sure the photo is sharp and under 10 MB
Fill in all required fields
If the error repeats, write to us with a screenshot

appBug.q: A page won't open or the app shows an error
appBug.a: Refreshing the page or reopening the app usually helps.
steps: Refresh the page, or close and reopen the app
Check your internet connection
If it persists, send a screenshot and tell us which page

notifications.a: Notifications are turned on from the profile and need browser permission.
steps: Turn on “Notifications” in your profile
Check the permission in browser or phone settings
On iPhone, add the app to the Home Screen first

front.title: Front
front.tip: The face of the product looks straight at the camera. Use a clean, plain background.

angle.title: 45° angle (main photo)
angle.tip: Step a little to the side so the front and side show together. This becomes the cover photo in the shop.

side.title: Side
side.tip: Show the profile: thickness, width and shape should be clear.

back.title: Back / inside
back.tip: Show the inner side, mounting points and connectors.

detail.title: Close-up
detail.tip: Shoot material, finish and seams up close. If there are scratches, do not hide them.

label.title: Label / part number
label.tip: The part number, size marks (R, ET, PCD) or factory stamp must be readable.

set.title: Full set
set.tip: Lay all pieces (bolts, brackets) side by side and shoot from above.

onCar.title: Result on the car
onCar.tip: Shoot the finished car from a 45° angle, the whole car in the frame.

surface.title: Surface close-up
surface.tip: Show the gloss and colour: let a light reflect on the surface.

light.dark: Too dark: move to better light
light.backlit: Light from behind: stand beside the window, not facing it

listingTips.anyLanguage: Write in any language. When you save, AI fixes only spelling and punctuation (it neither shortens nor adds to your text) and translates it into 8 languages. Buyers see the product in whatever language they use the app in.
